column2: Nuestra Senora de la Etica Laxa
column3: South of Key Lento, off Abismo Key.
column4: 5 pieces. Golden Pendant inside central hull under smashed wood; Golden Chalice south of hull beside a crate; Ancient Snuff Box by mast under purple sea fan; Ceremonial Spoon southeast of wreck in sand; Battered Doubloon in a buried chest beyond the southern reef. Pull the chest free, then open it. Sell the complete set to Kenton. Initial dive-site batch after Island Dreams. Dive sites are reportedly unavailable in Chapter 2 and return in Chapter 3.\nReported full-set sale: $1,000; check Kenton's offer before selling.

column3: Dive marker south of Key Lento, closer to shore.
column4: 7 pieces. Dragon Pipe: south by mast, net and broken timber. Purple Gemstone: stern beside barrel. Antique Candlestick: south past mast by large anchor and barrels. Ivory Saint: north against hull. Pewter Gauntlet: north near bow. Serpentine Statue: below bow. Stained Doubloon: buried chest beyond stern, reported west of it; sweep both sides if needed. Sell all seven to Kenton. GTA6 GPS map position for La Noche: X -2606, Y -7169. A separate Misericordia lead is at X -3245, Y -7533; treasure contents and set identity unverified. Initial dive-site batch after Island Dreams. Dive sites are reportedly unavailable in Chapter 2 and return in Chapter 3. The final Stained Doubloon chest uses Open instead of Search.\nArea sweep (Key Lento): Underwater Discoveries - Nuestra Senora del Ocio (ID 1416).\nReported full-set sale: $1,400; check Kenton's offer before selling.

column3: Island cluster southeast of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ancient Ceremonial Mask: south of hull in seagrass. Sacred Necklace: southeast amid sand and pots. Golden Glove: east end by coral. Rusty Doubloon: south-side sand at midship. Ceremonial Plate: north against a coral-covered rock. Jade-Eye Cup: west side of bow. Search the tall hull ribs; sell all six to Kenton. Second dive-site batch; follow Kenton's subsequent message. Dive sites are reportedly unavailable in Chapter 2 and return in Chapter 3.\nArea sweep (Key Lento): Underwater Discoveries - Urca de Cinco Torres (ID 1419).\nReported full-set sale: $1,500; check Kenton's offer before selling.

column3: Water southwest of the hooked islet, southeast of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ceremonial Bowl: southeast stern, near coral-covered frame. Golden Llama: northeast among stones and crossed beams. Golden Statuette: north by front mast and fallen plank. Ceremonial Knife: bow rocks by low crossbeam. Shiny Doubloon: northwest by coral patch. Jade-Lobe Tankard: south hull rocks near broken pot. Sell the full set to Kenton. Second dive-site batch; follow Kenton's subsequent message. Dive sites are reportedly unavailable in Chapter 2 and return in Chapter 3. An alternate report places the Shiny Doubloon chest at the southwest coral barrier, on sand away from the wreck; check both reported sides.\nArea sweep (Key Lento): Underwater Discoveries - Nuestra Senora Lujuriosa (ID 1420).\nReported full-set sale: $1,500; check Kenton's offer before selling.

column3: Farther offshore east of Key Lento.
column4: 6 pieces. Ornate Pocket Watch: remains of the stern at north end. Silver Hip Flask: east of hull by rocks and large broken panel. Brass Spyglass: west of bow at south end. Dividing Compass: west midship in debris and red sails. Santa Sierra Bell: northwest from red sails, by parallel timbers. Worn Doubloon: sand north of hull by coral-covered rock. Sell all six to Kenton. Second dive-site batch; follow Kenton's subsequent message. Dive sites are reportedly unavailable in Chapter 2 and return in Chapter 3.\nArea sweep (Key Lento): Underwater Discoveries - Urca de Santa Sierra (ID 1421).\nReported full-set sale: $1,500; check Kenton's offer before selling.

column3: Off southern Belpoint, west of Bobcat Bight.
column4:
5 pieces at the deep-water dive site. 5 finds: Ancient Bracelet; Ancient Ingot; Avian Plate; Golden Fish; Lover's Grail. Kenton set; NOT one of 33 Underwater Discoveries. An Ancient Bracelet is also reported beneath a submerged research station; check the seabed below the platform if the bracelet is still missing. Sources differ on the exact spot.
Area sweep (Belpoint): Standout Vehicles - Declasse Flamingo Bobcat (ID 2333).
Reported directions relative to map chest: Ancient Ingot: broad gap between rocks south of chest marker. Golden Fish: south, close to the Ancient Ingot. Avian Plate: southeast of chest marker. Ancient Bracelet: southwest of marker by boxes in submerged wreckage; compare older research-station report. Lover's Grail: short swim east of chest marker.
If late dive sites are absent, complete Kenton's Maritime Disputes first. Both late sites are reported to unlock after this mission.

column3: Reef off the west side of Bobcat Key.
column4:
6 pieces at the reef. 6 finds: Astrolabe; Captain's Whistle; Ceramic Pirate; Ivory Sundial; Naval Hourglass; Pirate's Buckle. Kenton set, NOT Underwater Discovery.
Area sweep (Bobcat Key): Cards / Jack of Hearts Dancers - Jada Watts (Silver) (ID 1032).
Reported directions relative to map chest: Ivory Sundial: south of marker at rock wall beyond the channel. Pirate's Buckle: east near circle edge, beside pale circular growth. Captain's Whistle: southeast near circle edge, at base of rock by sandy channel. Naval Hourglass: southwest, in narrow crevice near pointed rock. Ceramic Pirate: west of marker, sloping seabed near dark rock. Astrolabe: east, sand beneath dark overhanging rock.
Bring a boat equipped with scuba gear; Kenton's boat is reliable. Set credit appears after the sixth pickup, separate from Underwater Discoveries.
